title: The Stag in the Ox-Stall
author: Aesop (trans. V. S. Vernon Jones)
summary: 雄鹿躲在牛棚的干草里，躲过了工人，却没躲过主人的眼睛。
publicDomainBasis: Aesop's fables are ancient; this translation by V. S. Vernon Jones was published in 1912. Public domain in the United States and in China.

paragraphs.en: A Stag, chased from his lair by the hounds, took refuge in a farmyard, and, entering a stable where a number of oxen were stalled, thrust himself under a pile of hay in a vacant stall, where he lay concealed, all but the tips of his horns. Presently one of the Oxen said to him, "What has induced you to come in here? Aren't you aware of the risk you are running of being captured by the herdsmen?" To which he replied, "Pray let me stay for the present. When night comes I shall easily escape under cover of the dark."
paragraphs.zh: 一头雄鹿被猎犬赶出巢穴，逃进一个农家院子，钻进一间关着几头牛的牲口棚，在空栏里的一堆干草下藏了起来，只露出两只角尖。不一会儿，一头牛对他说：“你怎么跑进来了？你不知道有被牧人抓住的危险吗？”雄鹿回答：“求你先让我待一会儿。等天黑了，我很容易就能趁黑逃走。”

paragraphs.en: In the course of the afternoon more than one of the farm-hands came in, to attend to the wants of the cattle, but not one of them noticed the presence of the Stag, who accordingly began to congratulate himself on his escape and to express his gratitude to the Oxen. "We wish you well," said the one who had spoken before, "but you are not out of danger yet. If the master comes, you will certainly be found out, for nothing ever escapes his keen eyes."
paragraphs.zh: 那天下午，好几个农场工人进来照看牛群，却没有一个人注意到雄鹿。于是它开始庆幸自己逃过一劫，并向牛群道谢。“我们祝你好运，”先前说话的那头牛说，“可你还没脱离危险。要是主人来了，你肯定会被发现，因为什么都逃不过他锐利的眼睛。”

paragraphs.en: Presently, sure enough, in he came, and made a great to-do about the way the Oxen were kept. "The beasts are starving," he cried; "here, give them more hay, and put plenty of litter under them." As he spoke, he seized an armful himself from the pile where the Stag lay concealed, and at once detected him. Calling his men, he had him seized at once and killed for the table.
paragraphs.zh: 果然，不一会儿主人就进来了，还为牛群的饲养情况大发脾气。“这些牲口都饿坏了，”他喊道，“来，多给它们些干草，再多铺些垫草。”说着，他亲自动手从雄鹿藏身的那堆干草里抱了一捆，立刻发现了它。他叫来工人，当场把雄鹿抓住，杀了做菜。
